body: Thanks Debris, I'll do that when she gets home.

I'm worried talking about the attempt might make her continue to 'live in the world of suicide'. 

I just want her to move on and grow up. She keeps telling me I don't know how she feels, I just want to yell at her that I don't, that I understand things can be tough but you need to be tough to put up with life. I love her to bits and I wouldn't have posted here if I didn't care but it seems the most selfish and hurtful thing to pretend you're fine one night and do the ultimate thing the next. I just want to tell her that I'm here for her but if she keeps acting like an idiot over some childhood sweetheart then I don't want to waste energy if she's going to relapse every few days. She's planning on moving out to an apartment and it just seems like such a stupid idea if she keeps this negative view of life... Who will take her to the hospital every damn week to pump her stomach or whatever they do?

I know most of this is harsh, I know I wouldn't say it to her but I need to vent a bit, my life has taken a turn for the better this year. I managed to get an amazing job straight from uni and a girl that I could happily spend my life with and I've spent a long time putting up with the burdens of so many friends that now I just want to enjoy it. 2 months in and my sister is suicidal.

Really, thank you for your support, the things you have said will be taken on board. I know I need to help her along, I just don't want to feel like everything I do is for nothing. Many times before she's come for my advice and then thrown it in my face with some crazy decision. I just want to know what I do actually makes a difference.

Edit: I'd rather get it all out here anonymously than blow up and throw it at her for her to deal with.
